proposals.title: Eval ingest helper falls back across :4006 > :3001 > :5000 on 127.0.0.1 / workstation.local / 172.30.131.126 and records the source
proposals.rationale: One down port blanked the daily report. Default (no --url) tries 9 bases port-major; moves on for connection errors / 404 / 502-504 / LWP internal 500, stops on real answers. --bases overrides; --collect PATH [--out FILE] GETs e.g. /ai/usage_live with {collected_from, data}. Each ingest appends {file, report_date, base, url, code, tried} to data/ai_eval_ingest_sources.jsonl. Bulk code by Hermes on Super Grok grok-build-0.1 (session 20261006_070758_285649, 26 calls, $0), reviewed + use-lib fix by Grok Bot. Tests 38/38.

proposals.title: Grok Bot burn estimate: count turns, routine runs (incl. failed), teammate wakes; separate CSC HelpDesk line; fit %/event from readings
proposals.rationale: Bot went 9% (Mon Oct 5 10:04 PT) -> 12% (Tue Oct 6 07:01 PT); estimator showed the latest reading only (0 Ledger grok_bot rows) and missed ~3%. Now counts Ledger request_type grok_bot (metadata.event turn|routine_run|wake|csc_helpdesk, failed status included) + daily_eval rows + eval-report routine runs; fits %/event from same-cycle reading deltas; with no events between readings uses %/h from the deltas (marked ESTIMATED); time-based floor for unlogged activity. Today: 0 Bot events logged on the workstation, so the Bot line is estimated (0.44 %/h), not counted. Post events to /ai/usage_ingest source=grok_bot request_type=turn|routine_run|wake|csc_helpdesk.
